units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Targ. Esth. V, 14</cite>.
Targ. Deut. VIII, 9 (O. ed. Berl. בר׳); a. fr.—Pl. פַּרְזְלַיָּיא, פַּרְזְלַיָּה iron tools.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 24">Lev. R. s. 24</cite> <he>יהון מקשין בפ׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <he>מקשיין בפריזלא</he>, corr. acc.) let them rattle with the iron tools and say &c.; <he>הוון מקשין בפ׳</he> (ed. Wil. <he>בפרזלא</he>, corr. acc.) they rattled with &c.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 2:7:6">Y. Nidd. II, end, 50ᵇ</cite> <he>פַּרְזְלוֹי הריפין</he> his tools are sharp (he is an ingenious scholar, and does not need consultation with others, v. <cite ref="H00175"><he>חָדַד</he></cite>).
